name: Richard J. Burch
tagline: Top rated Civil Litigation attorney in Houston, Texas
about: Richard J. Burch attended law school and graduated from University of Houston Law Center in 1997. Richard Burch began practicing law in 1997.
Richard Burch is an attorney at Bruckner Burch PLLC, helping people with Civil Litigation: Plaintiff issues. Bruckner Burch PLLC has an office in Houston, Texas, serving the local community.

Richard Burch was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004, 2008 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
